sources.snippet: What this model is FELAY-1-ASTRA (COMB01) is an updated, coherent version of FELAY-1-ASTRA. It is built from the original FELAY-1-ASTRA weights by applying only the two winning FELAY Lab moves, selected because they improved the fixed in-lab evaluation and kept generation coherent.
